001_h1: Every story is a point of light.
002_p: This is a place to share the small, true moments when
003_p: “ME” and “WE” turn out to be one. We call that ME=WE.
004_b: Each story you add is one more point of light
005_b: in a collection we are building together.
006_a: New to ME=WE? Read the idea.
008_p: None of us sees the whole picture alone.
009_p: A teacher who changed how her classroom feels. A neighbor who knocked on a door. Someone who tried ME=WE in real life and watched what happened next. These moments are everywhere, and most go untold.
010_p: Your story holds something the rest of us cannot see without you. It does not need to be well-crafted; it needs to be yours. No spectators here, only people who notice, and pass it on.
012_h2: A moment when ME and WE turned out to be one.
013_p: Not a testimonial. Not a polished essay. Just a real moment, in whatever form it carries: a few sentences, a photo, a drawing, a song, even a recipe.
015_p: A moment you were in. You acted, and something changed — or did not.
017_p: In a meeting where nobody would speak, I put my hand up first. My voice shook. Afterwards two people came over and said they had been thinking the same thing.
019_p: ME=WE out in the world: a street, a film, something in nature.
021_p: A child gave up their seat on the bus. Three stops later another passenger did the same. Nobody said a word, but something had moved.
023_p: Someone else’s story, carried here by you.
025_p: My grandmother told me about the neighbour who opened a door during the war. That door is the reason my family is here.
027_p: A scene that has not happened yet. A hope, a what-if.
029_p: The empty lot on our street becomes a garden. Three households the first year, twelve the next. I have not turned the first spade yet.
031_p: You do not need the right words. Start with one honest moment, and see where it goes.
041_p: The Constellation grows as neighbors add their own.
045_h2: Three honest sentences is a story.
046_p: You do not need to be a writer. You need to be honest. Every story you add joins the Constellation we are building together, and some are chosen to feature here.
